convert_xml_element_to_string: convert an lxml XML element to a pretty-printed string with an optional XML header
extract_dict_subset_by_keys: extract a subset of key-value pairs from a dictionary given a list of keys
add_subnode_to_xml_element: add a new subelement by tag name or append an existing lxml element to a parent node
convert_object_to_yaml_representation: recursively convert Python objects, dicts, lists, and XML elements to a YAML-friendly representation
get_xml_children_excluding_comments: get a list of child elements from an XML node excluding XML comment nodes
